# Private assessment draft: Tandir lab · synthetic UI fixture

Private local draft. Human review required before export.

Source-free assessment of human-reviewed imported observations within the declared scope.

## Affected endpoints

- /orders/1042/invoice
- /orders/1042/receipt

## Proposed safe reproduction

- Proposed manual procedure only: use the designated accounts and synthetic objects within the explicit scope.
- Record a legitimate owner response, the same object/request under the other account, and a protected denial control; stop on unexpected sensitive information.

## Impact

- Potential impact is unestablished until the declared access rule, matching contexts and relevant synthetic-object evidence support it.

## Mitigation

- If the hypothesis is confirmed, enforce the declared access rule at the affected endpoint and repeat the same owner and denial controls.

## Tools and models

- Plumb deterministic inert-data importer, exact-field citation validator, observed map and manual comparison planner.
- No model inference was performed by this report export; recorded local-analysis details are included as recorded interpretations.

## Methodology

- Human attachment review precedes local storage; credentials are removed and unexpected personal information stops assessment activity.
- Observations, human expectations, comparison hypotheses, counterevidence and executed-run records remain separate.
- Every observation claim resolves to its artifact and exact sanitized field hash.

## Limitations

- Imports are user-collected observations, not independently verified runtime reproduction.
- A successful HTTP response or missing header alone proves no unauthorized access.
- Screenshots are reviewed attachments; image understanding is unavailable.
- Undiscovered endpoints, untested roles and application-wide security remain unknown.

## Imported coverage

- Imported observations: GET /orders/1042/invoice
- Imported observations: GET /orders/1042/receipt

- /auth/login

- /orders
